bio: Jason Edward "Eddie" Speir is a Republican candidate for Florida's 16th Congressional District. He founded Inspiration Academy, a private Christian school in Bradenton, in 2013, after a career in computer consulting. He challenged incumbent Vern Buchanan in the 2024 Republican primary and took 39% of the vote. The 2026 seat is open following Buchanan's retirement.
key_messages: End dark money and pay-to-play politics fueling overdevelopment
Fight reckless spending in Congress to reduce the national debt and inflation
Restrict H-1B visas and outsourcing to increase American wages
Oppose AI data centers as harmful to Florida's environment, privacy, culture, and jobs
Restore constitutionally limited government by reclaiming legislative authority from unelected bureaucracies
